_comment: Copy to ~/.vibe-trading/watch_plans.json. The watchdog re-reads this every run, so you can edit it live with no restart. 'positions' sets per-holding stops/targets (overriding watchdog.py defaults). 'alerts' watches tickers you do NOT own and texts you when a price is crossed.
_warning_stale_prices: PREFER stop_pct/target_pct OVER FIXED PRICES. A hardcoded stop goes stale the moment your entry price changes: a stop of 530 against an entry of 530.85 is a 0.16% stop, which any normal wiggle triggers instantly. Percentages re-anchor to your actual fill automatically. Use a fixed price only when it marks a real structural level (a support shelf, a Fibonacci retracement, the prior day's low) AND you have checked it against your current entry.

positions.note: percent-based, so it re-anchors to whatever the real fill was
backtesting favoured wide exits (10/-5) over tight (4/-3)

positions._example_fixed_price: only when it is a genuine structural level
positions.note: 206 = prior swing low; 225 = next resistance. Re-check after any new fill.
